newsitem.title: FRANCE: None killed as bomb explodes by Algerian school.
newsitem.headline: None killed as bomb explodes by Algerian school.

text.p: A bomb exploded on Monday outside a school for girls in El Harrach suburb, southeast of the capital Algiers, but there were no casualties and only slight material damage, residents said.
"The bomb went off outside Ourida Meddad high school at El Harrach. The explosion caused only slight damage," one resident in the neighbourhood told Reuters by telephone.
The bomb explosion came a day after a powerful car bomb ripped through the crowded Belouizdad avenue in central Algiers killing more than 20 people and wounding more than 60.

At least 100 people have been killed and more than 150 wounded in the first 10 days of the Moslem holy month in Algeria as fundamentalist guerrillas seek to disprove government claims that it has crushed their revolt.
